summary: Retest of iteration_2 fixes and full regression. Both previously reported defects are resolved. Backend suite is 27/27 green (added TestUploadOwnerVisibility to explicitly cover the user_id-on-create fix). Frontend end-to-end regression completed cleanly with the demo account: sign-in -> home upload dropzone -> upload sample_lab_report.pdf with context -> navigation to /report/{id} -> analysing state visible -> report headline/summary-card/key-findings/lab-values-table/doctor-questions render -> chat question streams a grounded assistant answer (672 chars) -> Share with my doctor downloads ClarifyMed-summary-<id>.pdf -> /history lists the new item with date + top finding + 'flagged values' count, and clicking it reopens the report page. Lockout retest with a throwaway account: 5x 401 then 429, and 429 for the correct password during the lockout window. PDF export: 409 while processing, 200 single-page PDF containing masthead, headline, plain-language summary, flagged values table, 'Questions the patient would like to ask' and 'NOT MEDICAL ADVICE' footer once complete.
seed_data_creation: Registered several TEST_*@clarifytest.dev throwaway accounts for isolation, lockout and owner-visibility tests. Demo account now owns additional TEST_ analyses (d6c03684... from the frontend regression and several TEST_409 processing entries from the PDF-409 test).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 27 backend tests + full frontend regression pass. New test class TestUploadOwnerVisibility asserts: immediate GET after POST /api/analyses returns 200/processing, the analysis appears in GET /api/analyses, /messages and /file are accessible, polling reaches complete, /summary.pdf becomes 200, and a second user gets 404. The demo account now has extra TEST_-prefixed analyses accumulating in history; not a defect but the main agent may want to prune periodically.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - both prior defects (server.py create_analysis missing user_id; auth.py lockout using request.client.host behind K8s ingress) have been fixed and verified end-to-end.
